title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
subtitle: Harvard's flagship intro CS course — from Scratch to AI
instructor: David J. Malan and CS50 staff
institution: Harvard University — School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
description: CS50 is Harvard's introduction to computer science and the art of programming. The course covers computational thinking, C, data structures, algorithms, Python, SQL, web development, and artificial intelligence — with problem sets that build real skills week by week.
topics: Data structures (linked lists, hash tables, tries)
Python, SQL, and web programming (HTML/CSS/JS, Flask)
